    "enriched_content": "The initial plan to build a simple REST API with authentication using Node.js, Express, and JWT is a solid foundation, but requires deeper technical scrutiny.         "Use environment variables for all sensitive configurations (e.g., JWT secrets, database URIs) and employ tools like dotenv for local development to enhance security and portability.",

}

Always version your APIs to allow for future changes without breaking existing clients
**When to apply:** When building any REST or GraphQL API
**Avoid:** Not versioning from the start, Too frequent version bumps

### API Rate Limiting
Implement rate limiting to prevent abuse and ensure fair usage
**When to apply:** For all public and high-traffic APIs
**Avoid:** No rate limiting, Same limits for all users

### JWT Token Authentication
Use JWT tokens with refresh token rotation for stateless authentication
**When to apply:** For modern web and mobile APIs
**Avoid:** Storing sensitive data in JWT, No token expiration

### Comprehensive Error Handling
Implement proper error handling with meaningful messages and appropriate logging
**When to apply:** Throughout all application code
**Avoid:** Swallowing exceptions silently, Generic error messages

Use structured logging with log levels and contextual information
